rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=200, val_chunk=5, train_n=400, epochs=20, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=10, tv_step_init=0.001, tv_lambda_init=1.0, tv_share_steps=False, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-12 (breast_ct). EPOCHS probe at the K=10 lambda-winner. Best so far = iter-10 (K=10, lambda_init=1.0, epochs=10) hr=0.1471. Depth FALSIFIED twice: iter-4 (K=50, dead lambda) and iter-11 (K=30, active lambda=1.0) both collapse to FBP -- the useful per-pass TV smoothing is fully delivered by K=10; more passes over-smooth back to FBP-RMSE. So hold K=10 and let the 20 scalars converge FURTHER. ONE KNOB: epochs 10->20 (K=10, lambda_init=1.0, step_init=1e-3, mse, per-iter, lr=5e-3, val_n back to 200). HYPOTHESIS: the lambda schedule was still climbing at epoch 10 in iter-9/10; doubling epochs lets it settle at a better per-iter lambda profile so hr rises above 0.1471. FALSIFIER: if hr saturates ~0.147, 10 epochs already converged the scalars and the ~0.147 plateau is the config-only ceiling for supervised-unrolled-TV on breast (step-collapse caps data-consistency; only TV-denoising of FBP is available). BUDGET: iter-10 K=10 epochs=10 ran ~750s; epochs=20 ~ +train ~ est ~1050s, under 1200s wall (val cost unchanged).
